info.title: Gallery API
info.description:
HTTP API for the self-hosted media gallery, served under the `/api` base
path. Bodies are JSON (an upload is `multipart/form-data`), and every JSON
field and query parameter is camelCase.

**Conventions**
- Reads return `200` with the resource or collection. A paged list takes
  `limit` (at most 100) and `offset` and sends its size in `X-Total-Count`;
  `GET /media` also pages by `cursor`, from the `nextCursor` each page carries.
- Creates return `201` with the created resource.
- Updates are `PATCH` and change only the fields sent; they return `200`
  with the updated resource. A `PUT` with no body adds something to a set
  (a list item, a blocked tag).
- Deletes return `204` with no body.
- Non-CRUD actions (login, migrate, scan, bulk operations) are `POST`
  verbs that return `200` with a small result object.
- A trailing slash is ignored: `/api/tags/` is `/api/tags`.
- Timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC, to the second (`2026-11-07T09:18:09Z`).
- Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`):
  `{ "type", "title", "status", "detail" }`, where `type` is a tag URI
  ending in a stable PascalCase name to branch on
  (`tag:gallery.mathdad.me,2026:MediaNotFound`) and `detail` is for
  display. A failed validation is `422` and adds `errors`, one
  `{ "message", "location" }` per broken field (`body.tagName`,
  `query.limit`). Malformed JSON is `400`; a rate limit is `429` with
  `Retry-After`.

**Auth** — a session cookie, set by `POST /auth/login`, `POST /auth/register`
or `POST /auth/passkey`, which the browser sends with every request. It is
HttpOnly, so the page's scripts never see it; `GET /auth/session` says who
it signs in. Writes are refused (`403 ForbiddenOrigin`) unless the browser
marks them same-origin (`Sec-Fetch-Site`) and they come from an allowed
origin. Reads are public; a write needs a signed-in account (or an admin),
except a small public allowlist (media tagging and the batched
`POST /media/by-ids` read).

patch.description:
PATCH /account/password — Change the password. Every other browser
signed in as the account is signed out; this one stays, and stays kept
signed in if it was.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

delete.description:
DELETE /account — Delete the account, with its lists, blocked tags and
saved searches. Body: { password }. An admin can't (another admin removes
the role first), and the last admin least of all.

403.description: IncorrectPassword, OwnAdminAccount (an admin can't delete their own account), ForbiddenOrigin

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description:
GET /account/blocked-tags — The tags whose media this account doesn't
see in listings, by name.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

put.description:
PUT /account/blocked-tags/{tagId} — Block a tag: media carrying it
leaves this account's listings. Blocking it again changes nothing.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.
Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description:
GET /auth/config — What the sign-up and login pages need to know:
whether sign-up is open, and the Turnstile site key (null while the bot
check is off).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.summary: Who this browser is signed in as
get.description:
GET /auth/session — The account this browser is signed in as, or null.
The page asks once as it starts, since it can't read the session cookie.

200.description: The account, or null when signed out

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

delete.description:
DELETE /auth/session — Log out this browser. The account's other
browsers stay signed in.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /auth/register — Create an account and sign this browser in as it.
Body: { username, password, remember?, turnstileToken? }.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until another sign-up is counted.

post.description:
POST /auth/login — Sign this browser in with a username and password.
Body: { username, password, remember?, turnstileToken? }.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until another attempt is counted.

get.description: GET /danbooru/category-mappings — All Danbooru→gallery category mappings.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /danbooru/category-mappings — Map a Danbooru category to a gallery
category. Body: { danbooruCategoryId, danbooruCategoryName, galleryCategoryId }.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.
Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /danbooru/tag-mappings — All Danbooru→gallery tag-name mappings.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /danbooru/tag-mappings — Map a Danbooru tag name to a gallery tag name.
Body: { danbooruTag, galleryTag }.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

patch.summary: Update a tag name mapping (the fields given)
patch.description:
PATCH /danbooru/tag-mappings/{mappingId} — Change a tag-name mapping.
Body: { danbooruTag?, galleryTag? }; a field left out stays as it is.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.
Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description:
GET /duplicates/report — The latest duplicate-scan report, with dismissed
pairs filtered out and each pair enriched with media file names/hashes.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /duplicates/scan — Run the perceptual-hash duplicate scanner and
return summary stats (images compared, candidates, duplicates found).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /duplicates/dismissals — Dismiss a pair of media items as not-duplicates.
Body: { mediaId1, mediaId2 }.

422.description: InvalidInput, MediaNotFound (an id with no item)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /lists — The account's lists: the default first, then by name.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description: POST /lists — Make a list. Body: { name }.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

patch.description: PATCH /lists/{listId} — Rename a list. Body: { name }.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

delete.description:
DELETE /lists/{listId} — Delete a list (not its media). The default
list can't be.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.summary: The media ids in a list
get.description: GET /lists/{listId}/ids — Every media id in a list, for marking cards.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description:
GET /lists/{listId}/media?limit&offset — A page of a list, the most
recently added first, with the list's size in X-Total-Count. Media
carrying a tag the account blocks is left out, as from every listing.

X-Total-Count.description: How many items the list holds that the account may see.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.summary: Add many media to a list
post.description:
POST /lists/{listId}/media — Add many media at once. Body:
{ mediaIds: int[] } (at most 2000). Ids of media that don't exist are
skipped. Answers { added }, how many weren't in the list already.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

put.description:
PUT /lists/{listId}/media/{mediaId} — Add media to a list. Adding it
again changes nothing.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

delete.summary: Take media out of a list
delete.description: DELETE /lists/{listId}/media/{mediaId} — Take media out of a list.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.summary: Your lists that hold this media
get.description:
GET /media/{mediaId}/lists — Which of the account's lists hold this
media, by id.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description:
GET /media — Media, newest first: the whole gallery, a tag search
(?tags=cat,-dog) or the items with no tags (?untagged=true). A numbered
page is ?limit&offset, with the listing's size in X-Total-Count; the
items after a page are ?cursor= with the nextCursor it ended with, which
items added or removed meanwhile don't throw off (infinite scroll).

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag names, any case; a leading '-' excludes (cat,-dog). Names that aren't tags are skipped.

parameters.name: untagged
parameters.description: Only items with no tags. Not with tags.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Items to skip: a numbered page. Not with cursor.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: A nextCursor from this listing: the items after it.

X-Total-Count.description: How many items the whole listing holds (paging by offset only).

422.description: InvalidInput, InvalidCursor, NoValidTagsSupplied (none of the names is a tag)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /media — Upload one or more files (multipart/form-data with files[]).
Media type is auto-detected from each file's extension.

files[].description: The files: images or videos, each at most 100 MB.

fetchTags.description: Queue a Danbooru tag lookup for each file added.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /media/{mediaId} — A single media item by ID.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: "tags" adds the item's tags, in display order, as `tags`.

200.description: The media item (with its tags when include=tags)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

delete.description: DELETE /media/{mediaId} — Delete a media item (DB row, file, thumbnails).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /media/random — A single random media item.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /media/count — The total media count, as { count }.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /media/by-ids — Media items by id, up to 200. Ids with no item are
skipped. A public read that is a POST only to carry a long id list.

422.description: InvalidInput (not a list of 1 to 200 ids)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /media/bulk-delete — Delete media items by id. Body: { mediaIds }.
Each is deleted on its own; the answer lists which were and which
weren't.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /media/{mediaId}/tags — Tags applied to a media item. Cached.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

patch.summary: Add tags to a media item
patch.description:
PATCH /media/{mediaId}/tags — Apply tags to a media item (implications
resolved). Body: { tagIds: int[] }. Returns the item's updated tag list.
Public (anyone may tag).

422.description: InvalidTagList, TagNotFound (an id with no tag)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

delete.summary: Remove a tag from a media item
delete.description:
DELETE /media/{mediaId}/tags/{tagId} — Remove a tag from a media item.
Returns the item's updated tag list. Public (anyone may tag).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.summary: Import Danbooru tags for a media item

get.summary: Where media items' queued Danbooru imports stand
get.description:
GET /media/tag-imports?ids=1,2,3 — Where each item's queued Danbooru
import stands (an upload's, or the commands'), for up to 200 items.

200.description: Each item's import, in the order asked

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.summary: Start signing in with a passkey
post.description:
POST /auth/passkey/options — A challenge to sign in with: any passkey
saved for this site may answer it, and names its account itself.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /auth/passkey — Sign this browser in with a passkey's answer to the
challenge. Body: { credential, remember? }.

422.description: InvalidPasskey (the answer is missing or unreadable), PasskeyExpired (no challenge waiting, or too old)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until another attempt is counted.

get.description: GET /account/passkeys — The account's passkeys, oldest first.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /account/passkeys — Add the passkey that answered the challenge.
Body: { credential, name? }. Unnamed, it is named after where it is kept,
when its maker says (Windows Hello, iCloud Keychain, …).

422.description: InvalidPasskey, InvalidPasskeyName, PasskeyExpired, PasskeyRejected (its answer didn't check out, or it is already added)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /account/passkeys/options — A challenge to add a passkey with, once
the account's password confirms who is asking. Body: { password }.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

patch.description: PATCH /account/passkeys/{passkeyId} — Rename a passkey. Body: { name }.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

delete.description:
DELETE /account/passkeys/{passkeyId} — Remove a passkey: it no longer
signs anyone in (the browser or password manager still lists it until
it is deleted there).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /saved-searches — The account's saved searches, by name.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description: POST /saved-searches — Save a search. Body: { name, query }.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

patch.description:
PATCH /saved-searches/{searchId} — Rename a search or change its query.
Body: { name?, query? }.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.
Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /version — The running application and API contract versions.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description:
GET /openapi.json — The generated OpenAPI 3.1 document.

Serves the spec committed to the repo (regenerated with `composer docs`),
so production does not depend on swagger-php being installed.

404.description: SpecNotFound: the spec has not been generated

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /docs — The interactive API reference (Swagger UI), pointed at the spec.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /tag-categories — All tag categories.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /tag-categories — Create a tag category. Returns the created category.
Body: { categoryName, color, description?, sortOrder? }

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

patch.summary: Update a tag category (the fields given)
patch.description:
PATCH /tag-categories/{categoryId} — Update a tag category: the
fields sent, the rest as they are. Returns the updated category.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

delete.description: DELETE /tag-categories/{categoryId} — Delete a category that has no tags.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.summary: List, find or look up tags
get.description:
GET /tags — A page of tags, by name unless ?sort says otherwise, with
how many match in X-Total-Count. ?search= ranks the matches for a name
(exact, then prefix, then containing), for pickers; ?filter= keeps tags
whose own or category's name contains it; ?ids= and ?names= look tags
up; ?exclude= leaves ids out. With ?include=counts each tag carries its
media and implication counts. Cached.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: A name to rank matches for: exact, then starting with it, then containing it. Empty ranks every tag by name. Not with filter or sort.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Keeps tags whose name, or whose category's name, contains this (any case).

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag ids to look up (at most 100).

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag names (any case) to look up (at most 100).

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag ids to leave out.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: "counts" adds each tag's mediaCount and implicationCount.

X-Total-Count.description: How many tags match, on every page.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description: POST /tags — Create a tag. Body: { tagName, categoryId? (default 1) }.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /tags/{tagId} — A single tag by ID.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

patch.description:
PATCH /tags/{tagId} — Rename and/or recategorize a tag. Body:
{ tagName?, categoryId? }; a field left out stays as it is.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

delete.description:
DELETE /tags/{tagId} — Delete a tag.
DELETE /tags/{tagId}/migrate-to/{targetTagId} — move this tag's media
to the target first, then delete this tag.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

delete.summary: Move a tag's media to another tag, then delete it
delete.description:
DELETE /tags/{tagId} — Delete a tag.
DELETE /tags/{tagId}/migrate-to/{targetTagId} — move this tag's media
to the target first, then delete this tag.

parameters.name: targetTagId
parameters.description: Move media to this tag before deleting.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.summary: Move a tag's media to another tag, keeping it
post.description:
POST /tags/{tagId}/migrate — Move all this tag's media to the target,
keeping this tag (now on no media). Body: { targetTagId }. To move and
delete in one step, DELETE /tags/{tagId}/migrate-to/{targetTagId}.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /tag-implications — All tag implications. Cached.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

post.description:
POST /tag-implications — Add "tagId implies impliedTagId".
Body: { tagId, impliedTagId }. Rejects cycles and self-implication.
Returns the created implication.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.
Seconds until a request is counted again.

get.description: GET /users — Every account, by username.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

patch.description:
PATCH /users/{userId} — Make an account an admin or not, or set its
password (which signs it out everywhere).

403.description: Forbidden (not an admin), OwnAdminRole (an admin can't remove their own admin role), ForbiddenOrigin

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

delete.description:
DELETE /users/{userId} — Delete an account, with its lists, blocked
tags and saved searches.

403.description: Forbidden (not an admin), OwnAdminAccount (an admin can't delete their own account), ForbiddenOrigin

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is counted again.

BulkDeleteBody.description: Media items to delete, by id.

CategoryMappingBody.description: Which gallery category a Danbooru category imports into; replaces any mapping it has.

danbooruCategoryId.description: Danbooru's number for the category (0 is General).

galleryCategoryId.description: The gallery category its tags import into.

DanbooruImportBody.description: Where to import Danbooru tags from.

danbooruPostId.description: A Danbooru post id to import from; left out, the post is found by MD5, then by visual similarity.

DismissalBody.description: A pair of media items that aren't duplicates.

name.description: Unique among the account's lists, without regard to case.

ListItemsBody.description: Media items to add to a list, by id.

mediaIds.description: Up to 2000 ids; ids with no item are skipped.

LoginBody.description: A sign-in by username and password.

remember.description: Keep this browser signed in for 30 days, not just until it closes.

turnstileToken.description: The Turnstile widget's token (action "login"), when GET /auth/config gives a site key.

MediaIdsBody.description: Media items to read, by id.

ids.description: Up to 200 ids; ids with no item are skipped.

MediaTagsBody.description: Tags to apply to a media item, with what they imply.

tagIds.description: The tags' ids; every one must exist.

PasskeyAddBody.description: A new passkey's answer to the challenge.

credential.description: The PublicKeyCredential navigator.credentials.create() gave, as its toJSON() writes it.

name.description: What to call it; left out, it is named after where it is kept, when its maker says.

PasskeySignInBody.description: A passkey's answer to the sign-in challenge.

credential.description: The PublicKeyCredential navigator.credentials.get() gave, as its toJSON() writes it.

remember.description: Keep this browser signed in for 30 days, not just until it closes.

PasswordBody.description: The account's password, confirming who is asking.

PasswordChangeBody.description: A new password for the signed-in account.

password.description: The new one, at least 8 characters.

username.description: 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores; unique without regard to case.

remember.description: Keep this browser signed in for 30 days, not just until it closes.

turnstileToken.description: The Turnstile widget's token (action "register"), when GET /auth/config gives a site key.

name.description: Unique among the account's searches, without regard to case.

query.description: As the gallery's URL writes it: "cat,-dog", or "untagged".

SavedSearchUpdateBody.description: A saved search's changes: the fields sent change, the rest stay.

name.description: Unique among the account's searches, without regard to case.

query.description: As the gallery's URL writes it: "cat,-dog", or "untagged".

categoryName.description: The name; unique without regard to case.

sortOrder.description: Where its tags come in a tag list: lowest first.

TagCategoryUpdateBody.description: A category's changes: the fields sent change, the rest stay.

categoryName.description: A new name; unique without regard to case.

sortOrder.description: Where its tags come in a tag list: lowest first.

tagName.description: The name; stored lowercase and trimmed.

categoryId.description: Its category; General (1) when left out.

TagImplicationBody.description: A new implication: applying the tag applies the implied tag too.

impliedTagId.description: The implied tag; it may not lead back to the implying one.

TagMappingCreateBody.description: A Danbooru tag name and the gallery tag name it imports as.

danbooruTag.description: The tag as Danbooru names it; one mapping each.

galleryTag.description: The gallery tag name it imports as.

TagMappingUpdateBody.description: A mapping's changes: the fields sent change, the rest stay.

danbooruTag.description: The tag as Danbooru names it; one mapping each.

galleryTag.description: The gallery tag name it imports as.

TagMigrateBody.description: Where to move a tag's media.

targetTagId.description: The tag that receives the media.

TagUpdateBody.description: A tag's changes: the fields sent change, the rest stay.

tagName.description: A new name; stored lowercase and trimmed.

UserUpdateBody.description: An admin's changes to an account: the fields sent change, the rest stay.

isAdmin.description: Make it an admin, or not.

password.description: A new password, which signs it out everywhere.

AddedCount.description: How many media items a bulk add put in a list.

added.description: Items added that weren't in the list already.

AuthConfig.description: What the sign-up and sign-in pages need to know.

signupOpen.description: Whether anyone may make an account.

turnstileSiteKey.description: Cloudflare Turnstile's site key for the bot check; null while the server doesn't check.

BulkDeleteResult.description: Outcome of a bulk media delete.

failed.description: Ids that could not be deleted (unknown, not a positive number, or failing).

Count.description: How many media items the reader may see.

count.description: The number of items, less any carrying a tag the account blocks.

DanbooruFetchResult.description: Outcome of a Danbooru tag import.

tags.description: The media item's tags after the import, in display order.

method.description: How the post was found: by the file's MD5, by visual similarity (IQDB), or by the post id given.

tagsCreated.description: Tags the gallery did not have yet, created for it.

DuplicateMatch.description: A duplicate media pair with similarity scores.

media1.description: The item with the smaller id.

media2.description: The item with the larger id.

ssim.description: Structural similarity (SSIM) of their thumbnails; null in older reports.

DuplicateMedia.description: A media item in a duplicate pair.

generatedAt.description: When the scan ran, as the report writes it.

imagesCompared.description: How many images the scan compared.

matches.description: The pairs not dismissed since, whose items both still exist.

message.description: What is wrong with the field, in words a person can read.

location.description: Where the field is: body.tagName, query.limit, path.mediaId.

ListIdList.description: The ids of the account's lists that hold a media item.

MediaIdList.description: Every media id in a list.

MediaPage.description: A page of media items, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Pass as ?cursor= (with the same filters) for the items after these; null when nothing follows.

MediaWithTags.description: A media item; with include=tags, also its tags in display order.

tags.description: Its tags by category sort order, then name (include=tags only).

sourceTagId.description: The tag whose media moved; it is kept, on no media.

targetTagId.description: The tag that received the media.

PasskeyOptions.description: WebAuthn options for the browser (PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptionsJSON to sign in, PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON to add a passkey), with a challenge this session answers once.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem details body, sent as application/problem+json with every error.

type.description: What went wrong: a tag URI ending in a stable PascalCase name (tag:gallery.mathdad.me,2026:MediaNotFound), which a client may branch on. It names the failure and is never fetched.

title.description: The HTTP status's reason phrase (Not Found, Unprocessable Content, …).

status.description: The HTTP status code, as the response has it.

detail.description: Why it failed, in words a person can read; for display, and it may change.

errors.description: A failed validation's broken fields, one entry each; absent otherwise.

imagesCompared.description: How many images had fingerprints to compare.

lshCandidates.description: Pairs that shared a hash band, before the distance check.

executionTime.description: How long the scan took, in seconds.

SessionResponse.description: Who this browser is signed in as.

user.description: The account; null when signed out.

SignInResponse.description: The account this browser is now signed in as.

TagImplication.description: A tag implication: applying the tag applies the implied tag too.

TagImportStatus.description: A media item's queued Danbooru import.

status.description: Where it stands; none: no import was queued for it in the last day.

error.description: Why it failed (failed only): blocked, refused, unreachable, ….

fileName.description: The file as uploaded, or as saved once it is.

id.description: The new media item's id (success only).

hash.description: MD5 hash of the file (success and duplicate).

tagsStatus.description: With fetchTags: the Danbooru lookup is queued; GET /media/tag-imports says how it went.

tagsError.description: With fetchTags: why no Danbooru lookup was queued (Danbooru is not set up on the server). The file is still uploaded.

UploadSummary.description: Every uploaded file's outcome, with totals.

results.description: One entry per file, in the order sent.

totalDuplicates.description: Files skipped as copies of items there already.

apiVersion.description: HTTP API contract version (SemVer); moves only when the API changes.

mediaType.description: An animated GIF is a video.

fileName.description: The file under /media/full/; its thumbnails are /media/thumbs/<name without extension>.webp and @2x.webp.

fileTime.description: When it was added (an upload) or last changed (an ingested file), RFC 3339 in UTC; listings are newest first by it.

hash.description: MD5 hash of the file contents.

bitsFingerprint.description: Perceptual fingerprint, 64 bits as 0s and 1s (images only; empty for videos).

duration.description: Duration in seconds; 0 for still images.

categoryId.description: The tag category it belongs to.

tagName.description: Lowercase; unique without regard to case.

mediaCount.description: How many media items carry it (GET /tags with include=counts only).

implicationCount.description: How many tags it implies directly (GET /tags with include=counts only).

TagCategory.description: A tag category (name, color, description, sort order).

color.description: Tag palette hue. Display only — never a semantic state name.

sortOrder.description: Where its tags come in a media item's tag list: lowest first.

username.description: What it signs in with; unique without regard to case.

isAdmin.description: Whether it may upload, delete and manage tags and accounts.

createdAt.description: When it was made, RFC 3339 in UTC.

FavoriteList.description: One of an account's lists of media.

name.description: Unique among the account's lists, without regard to case.

isDefault.description: The list the heart on a card adds to; it can be renamed, not deleted.

mediaCount.description: How many media items it holds.

SavedSearch.description: A tag search an account keeps by name.

name.description: Unique among the account's searches, without regard to case.

query.description: As the gallery's URL writes it: "cat,-dog", or "untagged".

Passkey.description: A passkey an account signs in with.

authenticator.description: Where it is kept (iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager, Windows Hello…), when its maker says.

createdAt.description: When it was added, RFC 3339 in UTC.

lastUsedAt.description: When it last signed in, RFC 3339 in UTC; null if it never has.

CategoryMapping.description: Which gallery category a Danbooru tag category imports into.

danbooruCategoryId.description: Danbooru's number for the category (0 is General).

galleryCategoryId.description: The gallery category its tags import into.

TagMapping.description: A Danbooru tag name imported under another gallery tag name.

danbooruTag.description: The tag as Danbooru names it; one mapping each.

galleryTag.description: The gallery tag name it imports as.

sessionCookie.description: The session cookie a sign-in sets: until the browser closes, or 30 days with "keep me signed in". Over plain http (local development) it is named gallery-session.
sessionCookie.name: __Host-gallery-session

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Sign-up, sign-in (password or passkey) and sign-out.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Media items (images + videos), listing, upload, and tagging.
